title: Volume asymptotics for trees of crossing circles
status: Draft; separate summed and directed degree-and-twist volume criteria with shared finite estimates, and an explicit first meridian correction under the summed condition
imports: Exact moving-meridian crossing traces, full tree contraction and physical scalar factors from Exact Newton calculus for tangles with a moving meridian, Proposition 6.1, Theorem 7.1 and Proposition 8.1.

Canonical factorial interpolation from Holomorphic source asymptotics and volume limits for strict Conway compositions, Lemma 2.1 only; no Conway grammar or volume theorem is imported from that paper.

Original positive geometric completion and absolute action-volume equality from Positive octahedra and primitive fillings for trees of crossing circles, Theorem 1.1. Each analytic criterion separately implies the geometric threshold and places its selected critical point in the same uniqueness chart.

Theorem 1.1 proves the summed-condition volume asymptotic; Theorem 1.2 retains its explicit first microscopic meridian correction. Theorem 1.3 proves the directed-condition volume asymptotic and a centered ratio 1+O(1/N); Corollary 1.4 supplies the independent degree-or-twist alternative. The directed proof does not assume the summed theorem.

The unconditional full Newton bounds, complex edge sum and exact Fourier trace are proved once in Sections 2–5. The joint summed proof is in Section 6 and the normalized directed induction in Section 7. All-orders, preferred-longitude and fixed-meridian-neighborhood conclusions remain separate.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
